entities.name: Charles Phelps Taft
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Charles Phelps Taft was an American lawyer and politician who served as editor of the Cincinnati Times-Star, and owned both the Philadelphia Phillies and Chicago Cubs baseball teams. From 1895 to 1897, he served one term in the U.S. House of Representatives.
